# Workbench — Complete Reference

> Workbench is a free, modern, browser-based low-poly 3D modeling, texturing, and animation studio tailored for MultiCraft, Luanti, Minetest, and general low-poly 3D workflows. It runs completely in modern WebGL browsers with zero installation required.

- Canonical URL: https://workbench.bond/
- Official Wiki: https://about.workbench.bond/wiki
- Concise Index: https://workbench.bond/llms.txt
- XML Sitemap: https://workbench.bond/sitemap.xml
- Community Discord: https://discord.gg/HMDT9pWWcz

---

## 1. Overview

Workbench combines a full-featured low-poly 3D modeling and animation workstation with an integrated suite of specialized MultiCraft and Luanti creator tools inside a single tabbed web interface. Users can open multiple 3D projects and utility tools side-by-side in tabs without leaving the browser.

### Key Highlights

- **Zero Install Web App**: Runs directly in desktop and mobile browsers powered by WebGL and Three.js.
- **Multi-Tab Workspace**: Switch seamlessly between 3D modeling tabs, built-in creator tools, and the Start Screen.
- **Dark & Pistachio Aesthetic**: Designed for comfortable long modeling sessions with crisp high-contrast dark surfaces (`#0a0a0a`) and pistachio green (`#BEF264`) accents.
- **Offline-Friendly Assets**: Local asset storage, project autosave in browser storage, and direct local file import/export.

---

## 2. 3D Modeling & Animation Workstation

### Core Modes

1. **Edit Mode**:
   - Create and organize cubes, meshes, locators, and nested bone/group hierarchies in the Outliner.
   - Precision 3D transform gizmos for Translate, Resize, Rotate, and Pivot/Origin adjustments.
   - Box UV and Per-Face UV editing with pixel-exact snapping and live UV viewport.
   - Mirror modeling, inflation, face extrusion, and mesh subdivision tools.

2. **Paint Mode**:
   - Paint directly onto 3D surfaces in real time or on the synchronized 2D texture canvas.
   - Brush, Eraser, Fill Bucket, Color Picker, Gradient, Draw Shape, and Copy/Paste tools.
   - Layered textures, custom color palettes, opacity/blend controls, and PNG texture import/export.

3. **Animate Mode**:
   - Multi-track keyframe timeline supporting Position, Rotation, and Scale channels per bone.
   - Linear, smooth (Catmull-Rom), Bezier, and step interpolation curves.
   - Real-time animation playback, looping, scrubbing, and Molang expression support.

4. **Display Mode**:
   - Configure first-person, third-person, GUI, ground, and frame display transforms for item and block models.

### Supported 3D Formats & Codecs

- **MultiCraft Character**: Pre-rigged MultiCraft character modeling template with ready-to-edit textures and limbs.
- **Generic Model**: Unrestricted low-poly 3D modeling format for game engines, renders, and custom pipelines.
- **Blitz3D (`.b3d`)**: Built-in Blitz3D codec allowing direct opening of `.b3d` models via Open Model into a Generic Model tab.
- **Project Format (`.bbmodel`)**: Full project save/load preserving geometry, bones, textures, UV maps, and animations.
- **Minecraft / Voxel Formats**: Java Block/Item JSON, Bedrock Geometry JSON, Modded Entity, OptiFine JEM/JPM.
- **Standard 3D Export**: glTF / GLB, Wavefront OBJ + MTL, Collada DAE, FBX, Sketchfab-ready meshes, and 2D/3D PNG renders.

---

## 3. Integrated Workbench Tools

Workbench includes dedicated creator tools accessible directly from the Start Screen in full-screen tabs:

### 3.1 Luanti Skin Studio
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/luanti-skin-studio/index.html
- Target: MultiCraft, Luanti
- Capabilities: Design, customize, and export HD 128x64 character skins with an interactive real-time 3D rotating skin preview, customizable clothing/accessory layers, and curated color palettes.

### 3.2 Multicraft Seed Viewer
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/mtc-seed-viewer/index.html
- Target: MultiCraft Mapgen v7
- Capabilities: Explore and visualize MultiCraft mapgen seeds, biomes, and terrain height maps with interactive 2D map navigation, zoom, and coordinate lookup.

### 3.3 Luanti Brush Studio
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/brush_metadata_editor/dist/index.html
- Target: Luanti, MultiCraft, WorldEdit
- Capabilities: Visual brush command generator for Terraform and WorldEdit workflows featuring radius/shape controls, block presets, and live isometric voxel preview.

### 3.4 MultiCraft Metadata Editor
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/metadata/dist/index.html
- Target: MultiCraft, Minetest
- Capabilities: Modernized item metadata editor supporting custom item names, lore, color formatting codes, tool capabilities, enchantments, custom item imports, and instant command generation.

### 3.5 Microcontroller Emulator
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/microcontroller-emulator/dist/index.html
- Target: Mesecons, MultiCraft
- Capabilities: Interactive Mesecons microcontroller logic sandbox with A-D pin toggles, 256-byte EEPROM memory inspection, step-by-step debugger, and Lua-like scripting.

### 3.6 Name Tag Asset Catalog & Inspector
- URL: https://workbench.bond/workbench_tools/nametag/index.html
- Target: MultiCraft, Minetest
- Capabilities: Comprehensive searchable database and technical ID inspector covering MultiCraft & Minetest blocks, items, tools, food, and mobs.

### 3.7 Creator Access Portal Tools
- Authorized Workbench creators can sign in or redeem an access token from the top **Access** menu bar to unlock additional WorldEdit and pixel-art conversion utilities directly inside Workbench.

---

## 4. Technical Requirements & Compatibility

- **Platform**: Web Browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iOS).
- **Graphics**: WebGL-capable browser for the interactive 3D viewport.
- **Pricing**: Free to use.
- **Hosting**: Static web application optimized for global CDN delivery at `workbench.bond`.
